assumption.statement: This is a prospective observation/data-acquisition protocol, not a claim that the specified fields exist in current public sources or local systems and not a simulation behavior rule. Collect decision opportunities and observed outcomes separately, with enough temporal and identity linkage to describe assignment, task choice, incoming prompts, switching, interruptions, and eventual resumption without reconstructing unobserved alternatives.
assumption.scope: P2.1 evidence completeness and future authorized direct observation or governed event-log extraction for generic ED behavior validation; no patient-identifiable data required in this repository.

observation_window: site/profile identifier or de-identified site class
observation start/end with timezone and clock-quality note
staff_and_assignment_state: pseudonymous staff identifier stable within the authorized dataset
role/skill credentials relevant to the observed tasks and their effective time interval
shift/actual-presence state and location/zone at decision time
persistent patient/room/zone assignment with start/end and whether observed or source-defined
decision_opportunity: trigger type: scheduled reassessment, new arrival/request, alarm/page/consult, task completion, movement/supply need, or other source-defined trigger
active task and state immediately before trigger
eligible actions at that timestamp, including explicit unknown/uncaptured alternatives
basis/source for each eligibility or exclusion edge
priority/tie-break fields actually visible to the staff member, when observable
task_and_prompt_events: stable task identifier and task type
parent task or interrupting-task identifier where applicable
task start, pause/suspend, resume, completion, abort/cancel timestamps and source confidence
incoming prompt identifier and source, distinct from staff-initiated task switching
response category observed: switch, multitask, acknowledge, defer, deflect, or other source-defined category
first subsequent task after interruptor completion, including none observed and right-censoring
interruption_and_resumption: interrupted task identifier and ancestry chain
interrupting task identifier and ancestry chain
elapsed active work before interruption if directly measured
eventual resumption of the same task, no resumption, or unknown; distinguish observation end/censoring
resumption timestamp and remaining work only when directly observed or measurable
handover/transfer of responsibility, if explicit; do not infer from signatures
movement_and_supply: origin/destination identifiers and graph/layout revision when observed
trip purpose and whether supply/equipment retrieval
depart/arrive timestamps and movement mode if directly observed
separate wait, active work, and transit labels with method/confidence; allow unknown
concurrency_and_context: other simultaneous tasks/resources/staff only when explicit events support them
break/shift boundary and in-flight task state only when observed
missingness, censoring, observer disagreement, and data-quality flags

analysis_rules: Use opportunity denominators: count observed actions against captured decision opportunities, and report uncaptured choice-set coverage separately.
Do not infer ineligible alternatives from non-selection, completed assignment, physical proximity, or absence of an EHR milestone.
Keep incoming prompt arrivals distinct from staff task switches and response categories.
Link interruption ancestry explicitly; identify the first subsequent task and eventual same-task resumption separately. Right-censor at observation end.
Do not derive active work, transit, switching overhead, eventual resumption, or simultaneous resource occupancy from coarse elapsed timestamps without direct supporting events.
Stratify and report role/site/time coverage and missingness; do not transfer sample rates as generic defaults.

Record original source bytes or governed extraction query/version and hash in the restricted evidence environment; store only non-sensitive manifests and derived aggregate evidence in this repository.
assumption.limitations: The available P2.1 sources do not jointly supply this full observation structure. The task-choice study abstract lacks a complete choice set and task lineage; the interruption abstract lacks eventual resumption and latency; the working-paper assignment lead does not provide a complete eligibility relation. This protocol identifies acquisition needs only.
assumption.owner: P2 evidence coordinator with local ED operational, observation, and data-governance owners
assumption.validity: Prospective schema/checklist; revise only through reviewed, source-backed protocol changes. It defines no clinical policy, action probability, frequency, duration, or default.

report_lineage.section: ABM evidence limits and observation requirements

review.notes: Coordinator-authored prospective observation checklist reconciled against P2.1 plan requirements. It is explicitly not a source-derived behavior model or empirical evidence record and does not fill local evidence gaps.
